headline: Traders Eliminate Bets on 50-Basis-Point December Fed Rate Hike
summary: Traders have removed the possibility of a 50-basis-point Federal Reserve interest rate hike in December following a recent market rout.
why: The Federal Reserve sets benchmark US interest rates, which dictate global borrowing costs, asset valuations, and macroeconomic conditions.

impacts.name: US Federal Funds Rate
impacts.why: Shifts in market pricing for Federal Reserve interest rate decisions directly influence short-term money market rates and US Treasury yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Changes in interest rate expectations alter yield forecasts and discount rates across financial markets.
